title: Painted Iron
description: the ability to dye all iron equipment to change it's colour
body:
**This datapack (and resource pack) allows you to dye iron armour, tools and even horse and nautilus armour!**

To use, install the datapack in your datapack folder, **BUT ALSO IN YOUR RESOURCE PACK FOLDER, AND ENABLE THAT TOO**, if you wish you can just use the resource pack and use commands to dye the tools and armour.
